"""Формы T-5: настоящие ограничения PostgreSQL, immutable catalog и закрытые routines."""

from __future__ import annotations

import psycopg
from psycopg import sql
import pytest

from .support import (
    applicability, database, definition, definition_with_shape, instance, owner,
    root, shape, snapshot_ordered_writes, subject_type, value,
)


FAMILIES = ("container", "subject", "object", "model")


def _families(connection):
    holder = root(connection)
    type_id = subject_type(connection)
    return type_id, {kind: owner(connection, kind, holder, type_id) for kind in FAMILIES}


def _insert_instance(connection, kind, owner_id, definition_id, shape_id,
                     value_type="integer", cardinality="set", type_id=None):
    columns = [kind + "_id", "definition_id", "shape_id", "value_type", "cardinality"]
    values = [owner_id, definition_id, shape_id, value_type, cardinality]
    if kind == "container":
        columns.append("container_type")
        values.append("organization")
    elif kind == "subject":
        columns.append("type_id")
        values.append(type_id)
    return connection.execute(
        sql.SQL("INSERT INTO attributes.{} ({}) VALUES ({}) RETURNING id").format(
            sql.Identifier(kind + "_instances"),
            sql.SQL(",").join(map(sql.Identifier, columns)),
            sql.SQL(",").join(sql.Placeholder() for _ in values),
        ), values,
    ).fetchone()[0]


def _shape_row(connection, chosen):
    return connection.execute("SELECT * FROM attributes.shapes WHERE id=%s", (chosen,)).fetchone()


def _registration(connection, key, kind="integer", cardinality="set", profile=None, version=None):
    return connection.execute(
        "SELECT attributes.register_shape(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
        (key, kind, cardinality, profile, version),
    ).fetchone()[0]


def test_shape_registration_contracts_and_keys(database):
    """Регистрация принимает все допустимые tuples и ASCII keys, отвергает неверные без следа.

    Проверяются string exact/unicode_ci single/set, DN set и пять native типов
    single/set; null/пустой/513/кириллический key, конфликт ASCII регистра,
    неверный профиль/кратность и отсутствующая/неизвестная версия отклоняются.
    Это защищает именно вход каталога, не подменяя DB immutable/FK проверки.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        versions = dict(connection.execute("SELECT profile::TEXT,version FROM attributes.comparison_facts"))
        contracts = [("string", mode, profile, versions[profile])
                     for mode in ("single", "set") for profile in ("exact", "unicode_ci")]
        contracts += [("dn", "set", "x509_rfc5280", versions["x509_rfc5280"])]
        contracts += [(kind, mode, None, None) for kind in ("integer", "decimal", "boolean", "date", "instant")
                      for mode in ("single", "set")]
        for index, contract in enumerate(contracts):
            chosen = _registration(connection, "Contract_" + str(index), *contract)
            assert connection.execute(
                "SELECT value_type::TEXT,cardinality::TEXT,comparison_profile::TEXT,comparison_version "
                "FROM attributes.shapes WHERE id=%s", (chosen,),
            ).fetchone() == contract
        for key in ("A", "X" * 512):
            assert _registration(connection, key) > 0
        first = _registration(connection, "EmployeeCode")
        count = connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM attributes.shapes").fetchone()[0]
        for key in (None, "", "X" * 513, "я"):
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.IntegrityError):
                _registration(connection, key)
            assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM attributes.shapes").fetchone() == (count,)
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.UniqueViolation):
            _registration(connection, "employeecode")
        assert connection.execute("SELECT key FROM attributes.shapes WHERE id=%s", (first,)).fetchone() == ("EmployeeCode",)
        invalid = [
            ("string", "set", None, None),
            ("string", "set", "exact", None),
            ("string", "set", "x509_rfc5280", versions["x509_rfc5280"]),
            ("dn", "single", "x509_rfc5280", versions["x509_rfc5280"]),
            ("dn", "set", "exact", versions["exact"]),
            ("integer", "set", "exact", versions["exact"]),
            ("boolean", "single", None, versions["exact"]),
            ("string", "set", "exact", "unknown-version"),
            ("dn", "set", "x509_rfc5280", "unknown-version"),
            ("string", "set", "unicode_ci", versions["exact"]),
        ]
        for index, contract in enumerate(invalid):
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.Error) as caught:
                _registration(connection, "Invalid_" + str(index), *contract)
            assert caught.value.sqlstate in {"23514", "23502", "0A000"}
            assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM attributes.shapes").fetchone() == (count,)


def _assert_immutable(connection, chosen):
    before = _shape_row(connection, chosen)
    ci_version = connection.execute(
        "SELECT version FROM attributes.comparison_facts WHERE profile='unicode_ci'"
    ).fetchone()[0]
    changes = [
        ("id=DEFAULT", ()),
        ("key=%s", ("ChangedShape",)),
        ("value_type='boolean',comparison_profile=NULL,comparison_version=NULL", ()),
        ("cardinality='single'", ()),
        ("comparison_profile='unicode_ci',comparison_version=%s", (ci_version,)),
        ("comparison_version=%s", ("changed-implementation",)),
    ]
    for assignment, params in changes:
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.CheckViolation):
            connection.execute("UPDATE attributes.shapes SET " + assignment + " WHERE id=%s", (*params, chosen))
        assert _shape_row(connection, chosen) == before


def test_unused_shape_whole_row_immutability(database):
    """Неиспользуемый shape защищён в БД при изменении каждого поля, включая identity/key.

    Семантические UPDATE предлагают согласованные tuples, поэтому отказ нельзя
    объяснить только CHECK допустимости профиля. Исходная строка сохраняется.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        chosen = shape(connection, "string", "set", "exact")
        assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM attributes.definitions").fetchone() == (0,)
        _assert_immutable(connection, chosen)


def test_shared_shape_whole_row_immutability(database):
    """Shape двух definitions с values нельзя изменить; все ссылки и значения сохраняются.

    Отказ каждого UPDATE проверяется deployment connection, имеющей прямой DML:
    закрытые runtime grants сами по себе не доказывают immutable trigger.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        holder = root(connection)
        chosen_shape = shape(connection, "string", "set", "exact")
        definitions = [definition_with_shape(connection, chosen_shape, key) for key in ("First", "Second")]
        for index, chosen in enumerate(definitions):
            applicability(connection, chosen)
            value(connection, "container", instance(connection, "container", holder, chosen), "text_value", "Original" + str(index))
        before = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM attributes.container_values ORDER BY id").fetchall()
        _assert_immutable(connection, chosen_shape)
        assert connection.execute("SELECT id,shape_id FROM attributes.definitions ORDER BY id").fetchall() == [
            (chosen, chosen_shape) for chosen in definitions]
        assert connection.execute("SELECT * FROM attributes.container_values ORDER BY id").fetchall() == before
        with pytest.raises((psycopg.errors.RestrictViolation, psycopg.errors.ForeignKeyViolation)):
            connection.execute("DELETE FROM attributes.shapes WHERE id=%s", (chosen_shape,))


def test_instance_shape_composite_fks_all_owner_families(database):
    """Каждое семейство отвергает чужой shape и неверные type/cardinality именно составным FK.

    Альтернативный shape имеет те же параметры: это доказывает фиксацию точного
    shape_id definition независимо от равенства semantic tuple.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        type_id, owners = _families(connection)
        chosen_shape = shape(connection)
        other_shape = shape(connection, key="OtherShape")
        chosen = definition_with_shape(connection, chosen_shape)
        applicability(connection, chosen, type_id)
        for kind, owner_id in owners.items():
            for selected, value_type, mode in ((other_shape, "integer", "set"),
                                               (chosen_shape, "boolean", "set"),
                                               (chosen_shape, "integer", "single")):
                with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.ForeignKeyViolation):
                    _insert_instance(connection, kind, owner_id, chosen, selected, value_type, mode, type_id)
            assert connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT count(*) FROM attributes.{}").format(
                sql.Identifier(kind + "_instances"))).fetchone() == (0,)


def test_instance_required_shape_references_all_owner_families(database):
    """Null и неизвестные definition/shape, null type/cardinality не оставляют partial instance.

    Все четыре семейства получают реальные owner/applicability; тем самым отказ
    относится к обязательным structural ссылкам, а не к отсутствующему владельцу.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        type_id, owners = _families(connection)
        chosen_shape = shape(connection)
        chosen = definition_with_shape(connection, chosen_shape)
        applicability(connection, chosen, type_id)
        invalid = [(None, chosen_shape, "integer", "set"), (chosen + 1000000, chosen_shape, "integer", "set"),
                   (chosen, None, "integer", "set"), (chosen, chosen_shape + 1000000, "integer", "set"),
                   (chosen, chosen_shape, None, "set"), (chosen, chosen_shape, "integer", None)]
        for kind, owner_id in owners.items():
            for selected, selected_shape, value_type, mode in invalid:
                with pytest.raises((psycopg.errors.NotNullViolation, psycopg.errors.ForeignKeyViolation)):
                    _insert_instance(connection, kind, owner_id, selected, selected_shape, value_type, mode, type_id)
            assert connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT count(*) FROM attributes.{}").format(
                sql.Identifier(kind + "_instances"))).fetchone() == (0,)


def test_value_fk_and_check_all_owner_families(database):
    """Values всех семейств сохраняют FK/type/cardinality/one-column CHECK и прежние данные.

    Неизвестный instance, чужой тип или кратность и две заполненные колонки
    отвергаются; откат также сохраняет mutation_version исходного instance.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        type_id, owners = _families(connection)
        chosen = definition(connection)
        applicability(connection, chosen, type_id)
        for kind, owner_id in owners.items():
            selected = instance(connection, kind, owner_id, chosen)
            value(connection, kind, selected, "integer_value", 1)
            table = sql.Identifier(kind + "_values")
            before = connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT * FROM attributes.{} ORDER BY id").format(table)).fetchall()
            mutation = connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT mutation_version FROM attributes.{} WHERE id=%s").format(
                sql.Identifier(kind + "_instances")), (selected,)).fetchone()
            cases = [(selected + 1000000, "integer", "set", None, 2),
                     (selected, "string", "set", "wrong", None),
                     (selected, "integer", "single", None, 2),
                     (selected, "integer", "set", "extra", 2)]
            for params in cases:
                with pytest.raises((psycopg.errors.ForeignKeyViolation, psycopg.errors.CheckViolation)):
                    connection.execute(sql.SQL(
                        "INSERT INTO attributes.{}(instance_id,value_type,cardinality,text_value,integer_value) "
                        "VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)").format(table), params)
                assert connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT * FROM attributes.{} ORDER BY id").format(table)).fetchall() == before
                assert connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT mutation_version FROM attributes.{} WHERE id=%s").format(
                    sql.Identifier(kind + "_instances")), (selected,)).fetchone() == mutation


def test_instance_identity_and_assignment_uniqueness_all_owner_families(database):
    """Пара owner–definition уникальна; owner/definition/shape/type/cardinality instance неизменяемы.

    Все четыре families проверяются прямым UPDATE под deployment правами;
    отказы guard сохраняют исходный экземпляр и его value, не перемещая данные.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        type_id, owners = _families(connection)
        chosen_shape = shape(connection)
        other_shape = shape(connection, key="OtherShape")
        chosen = definition_with_shape(connection, chosen_shape)
        other_definition = definition_with_shape(connection, chosen_shape, "OtherDefinition")
        applicability(connection, chosen, type_id)
        applicability(connection, other_definition, type_id)
        other_holder = root(connection, "OtherRoot")
        others = {kind: owner(connection, kind, other_holder, type_id) for kind in FAMILIES}
        for kind, owner_id in owners.items():
            selected = instance(connection, kind, owner_id, chosen)
            value(connection, kind, selected, "integer_value", 7)
            table = sql.Identifier(kind + "_instances")
            before = connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT * FROM attributes.{} WHERE id=%s").format(table), (selected,)).fetchone()
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.UniqueViolation):
                instance(connection, kind, owner_id, chosen)
            for column, replacement in ((kind + "_id", others[kind]), ("definition_id", other_definition),
                                        ("shape_id", other_shape), ("value_type", "boolean"), ("cardinality", "single")):
                with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.CheckViolation):
                    connection.execute(sql.SQL("UPDATE attributes.{} SET {}=%s WHERE id=%s").format(
                        table, sql.Identifier(column)), (replacement, selected))
                assert connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT * FROM attributes.{} WHERE id=%s").format(table), (selected,)).fetchone() == before
            assert connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT integer_value FROM attributes.{} WHERE instance_id=%s").format(
                sql.Identifier(kind + "_values")), (selected,)).fetchall() == [(7,)]


def test_scalar_cardinality_all_owner_families(database):
    """Во всех families single запрещает вторую строку сразу и пустоту при commit.

    После каждого отказа исходное значение 7 сохранено; проверка выполняется
    непосредственной записью values и не зависит от ранней валидации команды.
    """
    with database.connect() as connection:
        type_id, owners = _families(connection)
        chosen = definition(connection, cardinality="single")
        applicability(connection, chosen, type_id)
        instances = {}
        for kind, owner_id in owners.items():
            selected = instance(connection, kind, owner_id, chosen)
            value(connection, kind, selected, "integer_value", 7)
            instances[kind] = selected
    for kind, selected in instances.items():
        with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.UniqueViolation):
                value(connection, kind, selected, "integer_value", 8)
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.CheckViolation):
            with database.connect() as connection:
                connection.execute(sql.SQL("DELETE FROM attributes.{} WHERE instance_id=%s").format(
                    sql.Identifier(kind + "_values")), (selected,))
        with database.connect() as connection:
            assert connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT integer_value FROM attributes.{} WHERE instance_id=%s").format(
                sql.Identifier(kind + "_values")), (selected,)).fetchall() == [(7,)]


def test_instance_delete_cascades_values_preserving_shared_shape(database):
    """Удаление instance каскадно очищает только его values, сохраняя общий shape и соседей.

    По две definitions с одной формой используются в каждом семействе; удаление
    первой не должно удалять вторую definition, её instance, value или форму.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        type_id, owners = _families(connection)
        chosen_shape = shape(connection)
        first = definition_with_shape(connection, chosen_shape, "First")
        second = definition_with_shape(connection, chosen_shape, "Second")
        for chosen in (first, second):
            applicability(connection, chosen, type_id)
        before_shape = _shape_row(connection, chosen_shape)
        for kind, owner_id in owners.items():
            removed = instance(connection, kind, owner_id, first)
            retained = instance(connection, kind, owner_id, second)
            value(connection, kind, removed, "integer_value", 1)
            value(connection, kind, retained, "integer_value", 2)
            connection.execute(sql.SQL("DELETE FROM attributes.{} WHERE id=%s").format(
                sql.Identifier(kind + "_instances")), (removed,))
            assert connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT instance_id,integer_value FROM attributes.{}").format(
                sql.Identifier(kind + "_values"))).fetchall() == [(retained, 2)]
        assert _shape_row(connection, chosen_shape) == before_shape
        assert connection.execute("SELECT id FROM attributes.definitions ORDER BY id").fetchall() == [(first,), (second,)]


def test_shape_is_only_physical_comparison_source(database):
    """Comparator metadata физически находится только в shapes, старые facts возвращают его JOIN.

    Во всех families создаются реальные string values; проверяются отсутствие
    физических comparator columns и совпадение опубликованной tuple с shape.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        type_id, owners = _families(connection)
        chosen_shape = shape(connection, "string", "set", "unicode_ci")
        chosen = definition_with_shape(connection, chosen_shape)
        applicability(connection, chosen, type_id)
        assert {row[0] for row in connection.execute(
            "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='attributes' AND table_name='definitions'"
        )} == {"id", "key", "shape_id"}
        expected = connection.execute(
            "SELECT comparison_profile,comparison_version FROM attributes.shapes WHERE id=%s", (chosen_shape,)
        ).fetchone()
        for kind, owner_id in owners.items():
            selected = instance(connection, kind, owner_id, chosen)
            value(connection, kind, selected, "text_value", "Original")
            columns = {row[0] for row in connection.execute(
                "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='attributes' AND table_name=%s",
                (kind + "_instances",),
            )}
            assert {"shape_id", "value_type", "cardinality"} <= columns
            assert not {"comparison_profile", "comparison_version"} & columns
            assert connection.execute(sql.SQL(
                "SELECT comparison_profile,comparison_version FROM attributes.{} WHERE id=%s"
            ).format(sql.Identifier(kind + "_instance_facts")), (selected,)).fetchone() == expected
            assert "shape_id" not in {row[0] for row in connection.execute(
                "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='attributes' AND table_name=%s",
                (kind + "_instance_facts",),
            )}


def test_legacy_catalog_wrappers(database):
    """Прежние positional/named signatures сохраняют версию, no-op и атомарность без orphan shapes.

    Равная tuple использованного definition не создаёт форму; другая tuple
    отклоняется целиком. Дубликат key не оставляет форму, equal definitions не
    deduplicate, а заранее занятый generated key обрабатывается без коллизии.
    """
    with database.connect(autocommit=True) as connection:
        chosen = definition(connection, "string", "set", "exact", "Positional")
        named = connection.execute(
            "SELECT attributes.register_definition(new_key=>'Named',kind=>'string',mode=>'set',selected=>'exact')"
        ).fetchone()[0]
        assert connection.execute("SELECT count(DISTINCT shape_id) FROM attributes.definitions").fetchone() == (2,)
        holder = root(connection)
        applicability(connection, chosen)
        instance(connection, "container", holder, chosen)
        before = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM attributes.shapes ORDER BY id").fetchall()
        old_shape = connection.execute("SELECT shape_id FROM attributes.definitions WHERE id=%s", (chosen,)).fetchone()
        connection.execute(
            "SELECT attributes.change_unused_semantics(chosen=>%s,kind=>'string',mode=>'set',selected=>'exact')", (chosen,)
        )
        assert connection.execute("SELECT * FROM attributes.shapes ORDER BY id").fetchall() == before
        for statement, params in [
            ("SELECT attributes.change_unused_semantics(%s,'integer','single')", (chosen,)),
            ("SELECT attributes.register_definition('Positional','integer','single')", ()),
        ]:
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.IntegrityError):
                connection.execute(statement, params)
            assert connection.execute("SELECT * FROM attributes.shapes ORDER BY id").fetchall() == before
        assert connection.execute("SELECT shape_id FROM attributes.definitions WHERE id=%s", (chosen,)).fetchone() == old_shape
        explicit_version = connection.execute("SELECT version FROM attributes.comparison_facts WHERE profile='unicode_ci'").fetchone()[0]
        connection.execute("SELECT attributes.change_unused_semantics(%s,'string','single','unicode_ci',%s)", (named, explicit_version))
        assert connection.execute("SELECT comparison_version FROM attributes.definition_facts WHERE id=%s", (named,)).fetchone() == (explicit_version,)
        sequence = connection.execute("SELECT pg_get_serial_sequence('attributes.shapes','id')").fetchone()[0]
        last = connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT last_value FROM {}").format(sql.Identifier(*sequence.split(".")))).fetchone()[0]
        collision_key = "legacy_shape_" + str(last + 2)
        collision_shape = shape(connection, key=collision_key)
        fresh = definition(connection, key="GeneratedCollision")
        generated = connection.execute("SELECT shape_id FROM attributes.definitions WHERE id=%s", (fresh,)).fetchone()[0]
        assert generated != collision_shape
        assert connection.execute("SELECT key FROM attributes.shapes WHERE id=%s", (collision_shape,)).fetchone() == (collision_key,)


def test_dn_applicability_and_bind_share_definition_lock(database):
    """Обе очередности DN bind и расширения applicability не дают noncontainer DN definition.

    Два независимых SERIALIZABLE snapshot открыты заранее; loser получает
    serialization/constraint отказ, а итоговая shape/applicability пара допустима.
    """
    with database.connect() as connection:
        type_id = subject_type(connection)
        native = shape(connection)
        dn = shape(connection, "dn", "set", "x509_rfc5280", "DNShape")
        definitions = [definition_with_shape(connection, native, key) for key in ("BindFirst", "ApplicabilityFirst")]
        for chosen in definitions:
            connection.execute(
                "SELECT attributes.set_applicability(%s,ARRAY['organization']::containers.container_type[],ARRAY[]::BIGINT[],FALSE,FALSE)", (chosen,)
            )
    for bind_first, chosen in zip((True, False), definitions):
        def bind(connection):
            return connection.execute("SELECT attributes.bind_unused_shape(%s,%s)", (chosen, dn)).fetchone()

        def allow_subject(connection):
            return connection.execute(
                "SELECT attributes.set_applicability(%s,ARRAY['organization']::containers.container_type[],%s::BIGINT[],FALSE,FALSE)",
                (chosen, [type_id]),
            ).fetchone()

        first, second = (bind, allow_subject) if bind_first else (allow_subject, bind)
        _, state = snapshot_ordered_writes(database, "SERIALIZABLE", "SELECT id,shape_id FROM attributes.definitions", first, second)
        assert state in {"40001", "23514"}
        with database.connect() as connection:
            selected = connection.execute("SELECT shape_id FROM attributes.definitions WHERE id=%s", (chosen,)).fetchone()[0]
            subjects = connection.execute("SELECT type_id FROM attributes.subject_applicability WHERE definition_id=%s", (chosen,)).fetchall()
            assert (selected, subjects) == ((dn, []) if bind_first else (native, [(type_id,)]))


def test_instance_create_and_bind_keep_exact_shape_under_both_orders(database):
    """Создание empty set и bind обоих порядков не коммитят instance с прежней чужой формой.

    Старые snapshot воспроизводятся Barrier/Event без sleep; проверяется точный
    конечный shape_id и отсутствие partial instance после проигравшей записи.
    """
    with database.connect() as connection:
        holder = root(connection)
        original = shape(connection)
        target = shape(connection, "boolean", "set", key="Target")
        definitions = [definition_with_shape(connection, original, key) for key in ("InstanceFirst", "BindFirst")]
        for chosen in definitions:
            applicability(connection, chosen)
    for insert_first, chosen in zip((True, False), definitions):
        def create(connection):
            return _insert_instance(connection, "container", holder, chosen, original)

        def bind(connection):
            return connection.execute("SELECT attributes.bind_unused_shape(%s,%s)", (chosen, target)).fetchone()

        first, second = (create, bind) if insert_first else (bind, create)
        _, state = snapshot_ordered_writes(database, "SERIALIZABLE", "SELECT id,shape_id FROM attributes.definitions", first, second)
        assert state in {"40001", "23001", "23503"}
        with database.connect() as connection:
            assert connection.execute("SELECT shape_id FROM attributes.definitions WHERE id=%s", (chosen,)).fetchone() == (
                original if insert_first else target,)
            assert connection.execute("SELECT shape_id FROM attributes.container_instances WHERE definition_id=%s", (chosen,)).fetchall() == (
                [(original,)] if insert_first else [])

"""Компонентные проверки настоящих Alembic-миграций в отдельных PostgreSQL БД."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
import re

from alembic import command
from alembic.script import ScriptDirectory
import psycopg
import pytest
from psycopg import sql
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, event
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.exc import DBAPIError

from db_control.cli import (
    DeploymentRejected,
    RUNTIME_GROUPS,
    migration_config,
    migrations,
)
from .support import (
    DisposableDatabase, applicability, definition_with_shape, disposable_case,
    instance, shape, value,
)


SCHEMAS = ("containers", "subjects", "objects", "policies", "attributes")


@pytest.fixture
def disposable_database():
    """Создать и удалить только собственную tamarix_t3_* БД; отсутствие env — ошибка."""
    with disposable_case("migrations") as case:
        yield case


def assert_closed_foundation(case: DisposableDatabase) -> None:
    """Проверить закрытые ACL после первоначальной или повторной поставки."""
    with case.connect() as connection:
        rows = connection.execute(
            "SELECT rolname, rolcanlogin, rolsuper, rolcreatedb, rolcreaterole, "
            "rolreplication, rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = ANY(%s)",
            (sorted(RUNTIME_GROUPS),),
        ).fetchall()
        assert len(rows) == len(RUNTIME_GROUPS)
        assert all(not any(row[1:]) for row in rows)
        for group in sorted(RUNTIME_GROUPS):
            assert connection.execute(
                "SELECT has_table_privilege(%s, 'containers.nodes', "
                "'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE')", (group,)
            ).fetchone() == (False,)
            assert connection.execute(
                "SELECT has_function_privilege(%s, "
                "'attributes.protect_value_identity()', 'EXECUTE')", (group,)
            ).fetchone() == (False,)
        public_execute = connection.execute(
            "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p "
            "JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace "
            "CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner))) a "
            "WHERE n.nspname = ANY(%s) AND a.grantee = 0 "
            "AND a.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE'", (list(SCHEMAS),)
        ).fetchone()[0]
        assert public_execute == 0


def expected_heads(case: DisposableDatabase) -> list[str]:
    """Брать head поставленного migration артефакта, включая последующие revisions."""
    head = ScriptDirectory.from_config(migration_config(case.dsn)).get_current_head()
    return [head] if head is not None else []


def test_upgrade_empty_disposable_database(disposable_database):
    """На пустой отдельной БД upgrade создаёт основу, stable BIGINT ID и закрытые ACL.

    Проверка применяется к первой поставке: migration head, все предметные
    схемы/owner pairs и генерация идентичности должны существовать в настоящем
    PostgreSQL. Metadata модели не должна получать payload или reference columns.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    assert migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)["heads"] == expected_heads(case)
    with case.connect() as connection:
        schemas = connection.execute(
            "SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = ANY(%s)",
            (list(SCHEMAS),),
        ).fetchall()
        assert {row[0] for row in schemas} == set(SCHEMAS)
        tables = connection.execute(
            "SELECT n.nspname, c.relname FROM pg_class c "
            "JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace "
            "WHERE n.nspname = ANY(%s) AND c.relkind = 'r'", (list(SCHEMAS),)
        ).fetchall()
        assert {
            ("containers", "nodes"), ("subjects", "types"), ("subjects", "subjects"),
            ("objects", "objects"), ("objects", "key_guards"), ("policies", "models"),
            ("attributes", "definitions"), ("attributes", "shapes"), ("attributes", "container_applicability"),
            ("attributes", "subject_applicability"), ("attributes", "object_applicability"),
            ("attributes", "model_applicability"),
        }.issubset(set(tables))
        for kind in ("container", "subject", "object", "model"):
            assert ("attributes", f"{kind}_instances") in tables
            assert ("attributes", f"{kind}_values") in tables
        identity = connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO containers.nodes(type, key) VALUES ('organization', 'Root') "
            "RETURNING id, revision"
        ).fetchone()
        assert isinstance(identity[0], int) and identity[0] > 0
        assert identity[1] == 1
        model_columns = connection.execute(
            "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns "
            "WHERE table_schema = 'policies' AND table_name = 'models'"
        ).fetchall()
        assert {row[0] for row in model_columns} == {"id", "holder_id", "key", "revision"}
    assert_closed_foundation(case)


def test_repeated_upgrade_head_preserves_existing_rows(disposable_database):
    """Повторный upgrade head не создаёт схемы заново и сохраняет существующий root.

    При уже применённой revision повторная deployment-команда должна оставаться
    безопасной: OID таблицы, ID/данные строки и единственный Alembic head прежние.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    with case.connect() as connection:
        identity = connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO containers.nodes(type, key) VALUES ('organization', 'Root') RETURNING id"
        ).fetchone()[0]
        oid = connection.execute("SELECT 'containers.nodes'::regclass::oid").fetchone()[0]
    assert migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)["heads"] == expected_heads(case)
    with case.connect() as connection:
        assert connection.execute(
            "SELECT id, key, revision FROM containers.nodes"
        ).fetchall() == [(identity, "Root", 1)]
        assert connection.execute(
            "SELECT 'containers.nodes'::regclass::oid"
        ).fetchone() == (oid,)
        assert connection.execute(
            "SELECT version_num FROM public.alembic_version"
        ).fetchall() == [(head,) for head in expected_heads(case)]


def test_disposable_downgrade_and_upgrade_restore_closed_rights(disposable_database):
    """Явный downgrade удаляет только foundation схемы; upgrade восстанавливает закрытые права.

    Проверка разрешена только для собственной одноразовой БД. Повторная поставка
    не должна открывать PUBLIC EXECUTE, runtime DML или менять NOLOGIN group roles.
    Сохранение cluster roles позволяет не затронуть другую тестовую БД.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    assert_closed_foundation(case)
    assert migrations("downgrade", case.dsn, disposable=True)["heads"] == []
    with case.connect() as connection:
        assert connection.execute(
            "SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = ANY(%s)",
            (list(SCHEMAS),),
        ).fetchall() == []
    assert migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)["heads"] == expected_heads(case)
    assert_closed_foundation(case)


def test_unknown_schema_is_rejected_without_losing_user_data(disposable_database):
    """Неизвестная пользовательская таблица блокирует baseline без потери её строки.

    Случай защищает от случайной инициализации занятой БД: миграция должна
    откатиться до создания предметных схем и не удалять чужие данные.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    with case.connect() as connection:
        connection.execute("CREATE TABLE public.user_data (value TEXT NOT NULL)")
        connection.execute("INSERT INTO public.user_data VALUES ('сохранить')")
    with pytest.raises(DBAPIError) as caught:
        migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    assert getattr(caught.value.orig, "sqlstate", None) == "55000"
    with case.connect() as connection:
        assert connection.execute(
            "SELECT value FROM public.user_data"
        ).fetchall() == [("сохранить",)]
        assert connection.execute(
            "SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = ANY(%s)",
            (list(SCHEMAS),),
        ).fetchall() == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("group", sorted(RUNTIME_GROUPS))
def test_real_runtime_login_cannot_execute_ddl_or_broad_dml(disposable_database, group):
    """Каждый отдельный runtime LOGIN получает отказ DDL/DML/EXECUTE в закрытой основе.

    Параметры: container_service — контейнеры, subject_service — субъекты,
    object_service — объекты, policy_service — metadata моделей,
    catalog_operator — каталоги, fact_reader — подготовленные факты.
    Во всех шести случаях LOGIN имеет только соответствующий group membership,
    без deployment полномочий. Пока protected APIs не поставлены, даже каталоговая
    и reader роли не должны обходить закрытые ACL прямой записью или функцией.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    runtime = case.runtime_dsn(group)
    statements = (
        "CREATE TABLE containers.forbidden_table (id BIGINT)",
        "ALTER TABLE containers.nodes ADD COLUMN forbidden_column TEXT",
        "INSERT INTO containers.nodes(type, key) VALUES ('organization', 'Denied')",
        "UPDATE containers.nodes SET revision = 2",
        "DELETE FROM containers.nodes",
        "TRUNCATE containers.nodes",
        "SELECT attributes.protect_value_identity()",
    )
    with psycopg.connect(runtime, autocommit=True) as connection:
        for statement in statements:
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege):
                connection.execute(statement)
    with case.connect() as connection:
        assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM containers.nodes").fetchone() == (0,)
        assert connection.execute(
            "SELECT to_regclass('containers.forbidden_table')"
        ).fetchone() == (None,)


def test_downgrade_requires_explicit_disposable_safeguard(disposable_database):
    """CLI и прямой Alembic downgrade без disposable safeguard сохраняют основу.

    Проверка предотвращает обход ограничения через Python Alembic API:
    отсутствие config flag должно отклоняться самой revision, а не только CLI.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    with pytest.raises(DeploymentRejected, match="EXPLICIT_DISPOSABLE_FLAG_REQUIRED"):
        migrations("downgrade", case.dsn)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="disposable"):
        command.downgrade(migration_config(case.dsn), "base")
    assert migrations("current", case.dsn)["heads"] == expected_heads(case)
    assert_closed_foundation(case)


LEGACY_HEAD = "20261015_0003"
LEGACY_VIEWS = (
    "containers.node_facts", "containers.dn_facts", "subjects.type_facts",
    "subjects.active_facts", "subjects.administration_facts", "objects.object_facts",
    "policies.model_metadata_facts", "attributes.definition_facts", "attributes.comparison_facts",
    *("attributes." + kind + "_applicability_facts" for kind in ("container", "subject", "object", "model")),
    *("attributes." + kind + suffix for kind in ("container", "subject", "object", "model")
      for suffix in ("_instance_facts", "_value_facts")),
    "attributes.active_subject_instance_facts", "attributes.active_subject_value_facts",
)


def _dn_name(text, tag=19):
    """Малый независимый DER fixture CN; preparation остаётся обязанностью SQL codec."""
    raw = text.encode("ascii")
    ava = b"\x06\x03\x55\x04\x03" + bytes((tag, len(raw))) + raw
    sequence = b"\x30" + bytes((len(ava),)) + ava
    rdn = b"\x31" + bytes((len(sequence),)) + sequence
    return b"\x30" + bytes((len(rdn),)) + rdn


def _legacy_instance(connection, family, owner_id, definition_id, type_id):
    """Записать именно старые columns 0003; new support.instance здесь неприменим."""
    columns = [family + "_id", "definition_id", "value_type", "cardinality", "comparison_profile", "comparison_version"]
    expressions = ["%s", "d.id", "d.value_type", "d.cardinality", "d.comparison_profile", "d.comparison_version"]
    params = [owner_id]
    if family == "container":
        columns.append("container_type")
        expressions.append("'organization'")
    elif family == "subject":
        columns.append("type_id")
        expressions.append("%s")
        params.append(type_id)
    params.append(definition_id)
    return connection.execute(sql.SQL(
        "INSERT INTO attributes.{} ({}) SELECT {} FROM attributes.definitions d WHERE d.id=%s RETURNING id"
    ).format(sql.Identifier(family + "_instances"), sql.SQL(",").join(map(sql.Identifier, columns)),
             sql.SQL(",").join(map(sql.SQL, expressions))), params).fetchone()[0]


def _seed_legacy(case):
    """Создать заполненную 0003: все families/types, scalar/set/empty, retained tombstone и DN."""
    command.upgrade(migration_config(case.dsn), LEGACY_HEAD)
    with case.connect() as connection:
        holder = connection.execute("INSERT INTO containers.nodes(type,key) VALUES('organization','MigratedRoot') RETURNING id").fetchone()[0]
        type_id = connection.execute("SELECT subjects.register_type('MigrationUser')").fetchone()[0]
        subject = connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO subjects.subjects(holder_id,type_id,key) VALUES(%s,%s,'ActiveSubject') RETURNING id", (holder, type_id)
        ).fetchone()[0]
        tombstone = connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO subjects.subjects(holder_id,type_id,key) VALUES(%s,%s,'RetainedSubject') RETURNING id", (holder, type_id)
        ).fetchone()[0]
        obj = connection.execute("INSERT INTO objects.objects(holder_id,key) VALUES(%s,'MigratedObject') RETURNING id", (holder,)).fetchone()[0]
        model = connection.execute("INSERT INTO policies.models(holder_id,key) VALUES(%s,'MigratedModel') RETURNING id", (holder,)).fetchone()[0]
        owners = {"container": holder, "subject": subject, "object": obj, "model": model}
        examples = {
            "string": ("A\u030a", " å"), "integer": (-(2**63), 2**63 - 1),
            "decimal": (Decimal("1234.5600"), Decimal("-0.125")), "boolean": (False, True),
            "date": (date(2026, 10, 16), date(1970, 1, 1)),
            "instant": (datetime(2026, 10, 16, 12, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc), datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)),
        }
        columns = {"string": "text_value", "integer": "integer_value", "decimal": "decimal_value",
                   "boolean": "boolean_value", "date": "date_value", "instant": "instant_value"}
        for kind, items in examples.items():
            for mode in ("single", "set"):
                profile = ("exact" if mode == "single" else "unicode_ci") if kind == "string" else None
                chosen = connection.execute("SELECT attributes.register_definition(%s,%s,%s,%s)",
                                            ("Migration_" + kind + "_" + mode, kind, mode, profile)).fetchone()[0]
                applicability(connection, chosen, type_id)
                for family, owner_id in owners.items():
                    selected = _legacy_instance(connection, family, owner_id, chosen, type_id)
                    for item in items[:1] if mode == "single" else items:
                        value(connection, family, selected, columns[kind], item)
        empty = connection.execute("SELECT attributes.register_definition('EmptySet','integer','set')").fetchone()[0]
        applicability(connection, empty, type_id)
        for family, owner_id in owners.items():
            _legacy_instance(connection, family, owner_id, empty, type_id)
        retained = connection.execute("SELECT attributes.register_definition('Retained','string','set','exact')").fetchone()[0]
        applicability(connection, retained, type_id)
        retained_instance = _legacy_instance(connection, "subject", tombstone, retained, type_id)
        value(connection, "subject", retained_instance, "text_value", "Original retained spelling")
        exact = connection.execute("SELECT attributes.register_definition('ExactSpelling','string','set','exact')").fetchone()[0]
        applicability(connection, exact)
        selected = _legacy_instance(connection, "container", holder, exact, type_id)
        for text in ("A", "a", "é", "e\u0301", " a"):
            value(connection, "container", selected, "text_value", text)
        dn = connection.execute("SELECT attributes.register_definition('MigrationDN','dn','set','x509_rfc5280')").fetchone()[0]
        connection.execute(
            "SELECT attributes.set_applicability(%s,ARRAY['organization']::containers.container_type[],ARRAY[]::BIGINT[],FALSE,FALSE)", (dn,)
        )
        selected = _legacy_instance(connection, "container", holder, dn, type_id)
        value(connection, "container", selected, "dn_value", _dn_name("Example"))
        connection.execute("UPDATE containers.nodes SET revision=17 WHERE id=%s", (holder,))
        connection.execute("UPDATE subjects.subjects SET revision=8 WHERE id=%s", (subject,))
        connection.execute("UPDATE subjects.subjects SET revision=11,deleted_at='2026-10-15T12:00:00Z' WHERE id=%s", (tombstone,))
        connection.execute("UPDATE objects.objects SET revision=9 WHERE id=%s", (obj,))
        connection.execute("UPDATE policies.models SET revision=13 WHERE id=%s", (model,))
    return holder


def _legacy_snapshot(case):
    """Снять наблюдаемые данные и прежние view/routine contracts без новых shape columns."""
    with case.connect() as connection:
        result = {view: connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT * FROM {} ORDER BY 1,2").format(
            sql.Identifier(*view.split(".")))).fetchall() for view in LEGACY_VIEWS}
        for table in ("containers.nodes", "subjects.subjects", "objects.objects", "policies.models", "objects.key_guards"):
            result[table] = connection.execute(sql.SQL("SELECT * FROM {} ORDER BY 1").format(sql.Identifier(*table.split(".")))).fetchall()
        result["view_columns"] = connection.execute(
            "SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,a.attnum,a.attname,a.atttypid::regtype::TEXT,a.atttypmod,a.attcollation "
            "FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid "
            "WHERE n.nspname||'.'||c.relname=ANY(%s) AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY 1,2", (list(LEGACY_VIEWS),)
        ).fetchall()
        result["view_acl"] = connection.execute(
            "SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,owner.rolname,COALESCE(grantee.rolname,'PUBLIC'),acl.privilege_type,acl.is_grantable "
            "FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_roles owner ON owner.oid=c.relowner "
            "CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner))) acl "
            "LEFT JOIN pg_roles grantee ON grantee.oid=acl.grantee WHERE n.nspname||'.'||c.relname=ANY(%s) ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5",
            (list(LEGACY_VIEWS),)
        ).fetchall()
        result["legacy_catalog_signatures"] = connection.execute(
            "SELECT p.proname,pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),p.prorettype::regtype::TEXT,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig "
            "FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace "
            "WHERE n.nspname='attributes' AND p.proname=ANY(%s) ORDER BY 1,2",
            (["register_definition", "change_unused_semantics", "set_applicability"],)
        ).fetchall()
    return result


def _schema_snapshot(case):
    """Каталог текущей схемы для проверки полного rollback, а не только числа строк."""
    with case.connect() as connection:
        return {
            "relations": connection.execute(
                "SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind,c.oid,c.relowner,c.relacl::TEXT FROM pg_class c "
                "JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) ORDER BY 1,2", (list(SCHEMAS),)
            ).fetchall(),
            "columns": connection.execute(
                "SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum,a.attname,a.atttypid,a.atttypmod,a.attnotnull,a.attisdropped "
                "FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid "
                "WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND a.attnum>0 ORDER BY 1,2,3", (list(SCHEMAS),)
            ).fetchall(),
            "constraints": connection.execute(
                "SELECT n.nspname,c.relname,k.conname,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) FROM pg_constraint k "
                "JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace "
                "WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) ORDER BY 1,2,3", (list(SCHEMAS),)
            ).fetchall(),
            "routines": connection.execute(
                "SELECT n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),p.prosrc,p.proacl::TEXT "
                "FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) ORDER BY 1,2,3", (list(SCHEMAS),)
            ).fetchall(),
            "heads": connection.execute("SELECT version_num FROM public.alembic_version ORDER BY version_num").fetchall(),
        }


def _assert_backfilled_shapes(case, legacy):
    with case.connect() as connection:
        definitions = legacy["attributes.definition_facts"]
        mapping = connection.execute(
            "SELECT d.id,d.shape_id,s.key,s.value_type,s.cardinality,s.comparison_profile,s.comparison_version "
            "FROM attributes.definitions d JOIN attributes.shapes s ON s.id=d.shape_id ORDER BY d.id"
        ).fetchall()
        assert len({row[1] for row in mapping}) == len(definitions)
        assert [(row[0], *row[3:]) for row in mapping] == [(row[0], *row[2:]) for row in definitions]
        assert all(row[2] == 'migrated_definition_' + str(row[0]) for row in mapping)
        for family in ("container", "subject", "object", "model"):
            assert connection.execute(sql.SQL(
                "SELECT count(*) FROM attributes.{} i JOIN attributes.definitions d ON d.id=i.definition_id "
                "JOIN attributes.shapes s ON s.id=i.shape_id WHERE i.shape_id<>d.shape_id "
                "OR i.value_type<>s.value_type OR i.cardinality<>s.cardinality"
            ).format(sql.Identifier(family + "_instances"))).fetchone() == (0,)


def test_shapes_upgrade_preserves_existing_catalog_and_values(disposable_database):
    """Заполненная 0003 переходит к shapes без изменения IDs/values/revisions/views/ACL и DN keys.

    Содержит все families и native types, empty sets и retained tombstone.
    Проверяются one-shape-per-definition map, точные структурные ссылки и
    неизменность повторного head upgrade; новый fixture с одной head этого не доказывает.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    _seed_legacy(case)
    before = _legacy_snapshot(case)
    assert migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)["heads"] == expected_heads(case)
    assert _legacy_snapshot(case) == before
    _assert_backfilled_shapes(case, before)
    with case.connect() as connection:
        version = connection.execute("SELECT version FROM attributes.comparison_facts WHERE profile='x509_rfc5280'").fetchone()[0]
        assert connection.execute("SELECT attributes.dn_comparison_key(%s,%s)=attributes.dn_comparison_key(%s,%s)",
                                  (_dn_name("Example"), version, _dn_name("example", 12), version)).fetchone() == (True,)
    structure = _schema_snapshot(case)
    migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    assert _legacy_snapshot(case) == before
    assert _schema_snapshot(case) == structure
    assert_closed_foundation(case)


def test_shapes_upgrade_failure_rolls_back_schema_and_data(disposable_database):
    """Ошибка после фактического создания shapes, но до commit возвращает целую заполненную 0003.

    Test-only SQLAlchemy callback прерывает настоящий migration execution после
    DDL; затем отдельный blocker воспроизводит lock_timeout. Исходные SQL/resources
    не меняются. Сверка включает данные, columns, constraints, routines,
    view ACL/OID и прежнюю Alembic revision после каждого отказа.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    _seed_legacy(case)
    before, schema = _legacy_snapshot(case), _schema_snapshot(case)
    injected = False

    def abort_after_shape_ddl(connection, cursor, statement, parameters, context, executemany):
        nonlocal injected
        if re.search(r"CREATE\s+TABLE\s+attributes\.shapes\b", statement, re.IGNORECASE):
            injected = True
            raise RuntimeError("T5_TEST_ABORT_BEFORE_COMMIT")

    event.listen(Engine, "after_cursor_execute", abort_after_shape_ddl)
    try:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="T5_TEST_ABORT_BEFORE_COMMIT"):
            migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    finally:
        event.remove(Engine, "after_cursor_execute", abort_after_shape_ddl)
    assert injected
    assert _legacy_snapshot(case) == before
    assert _schema_snapshot(case) == schema
    with case.connect() as connection:
        assert connection.execute("SELECT to_regclass('attributes.shapes')").fetchone() == (None,)
    config = migration_config(case.dsn)
    engine = create_engine(config.attributes["database_url"], hide_parameters=True)
    try:
        with case.connect() as blocker:
            blocker.execute("LOCK TABLE attributes.definitions IN ACCESS SHARE MODE")
            with engine.connect() as connection:
                connection.exec_driver_sql("SET lock_timeout='100ms'")
                config.attributes["shapes_lock_timeout"] = "100ms"
                connection.commit()
                config.attributes["connection"] = connection
                with pytest.raises(DBAPIError) as caught:
                    command.upgrade(config, "head")
                assert caught.value.orig.sqlstate == "55P03"
    finally:
        engine.dispose()
    assert _legacy_snapshot(case) == before
    assert _schema_snapshot(case) == schema


def test_shapes_disposable_downgrade_restores_previous_contract(disposable_database):
    """Filled new→0003→head сохраняет старые факты и DN, явно теряя shape key/id/sharing.

    Сначала добавляются две definitions с общей именованной формой и values;
    reverse разрешён только disposable flag. После нового upgrade каждая
    definition получает собственный migrated shape без обещания восстановления UI metadata.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    holder = _seed_legacy(case)
    migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    with case.connect() as connection:
        shared = shape(connection, key="ExplicitSharedShape")
        unused = shape(connection, key="ExplicitUnusedShape")
        definitions = [definition_with_shape(connection, shared, key) for key in ("SharedOne", "SharedTwo")]
        for index, chosen in enumerate(definitions):
            applicability(connection, chosen)
            value(connection, "container", instance(connection, "container", holder, chosen), "integer_value", 100 + index)
        assert shared != unused
    before = _legacy_snapshot(case)
    config = migration_config(case.dsn)
    config.attributes["allow_disposable_downgrade"] = True
    command.downgrade(config, LEGACY_HEAD)
    assert _legacy_snapshot(case) == before
    with case.connect() as connection:
        assert connection.execute("SELECT to_regclass('attributes.shapes')").fetchone() == (None,)
        assert connection.execute("SELECT version_num FROM public.alembic_version").fetchone() == (LEGACY_HEAD,)
        assert connection.execute("SELECT value_type,cardinality FROM attributes.definitions WHERE id=ANY(%s) ORDER BY id", (definitions,)).fetchall() == [("integer", "set"), ("integer", "set")]
    migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    assert _legacy_snapshot(case) == before
    _assert_backfilled_shapes(case, before)
    with case.connect() as connection:
        assert connection.execute("SELECT count(DISTINCT shape_id) FROM attributes.definitions WHERE id=ANY(%s)", (definitions,)).fetchone() == (2,)
        assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM attributes.shapes WHERE key IN ('ExplicitSharedShape','ExplicitUnusedShape')").fetchone() == (0,)
    assert_closed_foundation(case)


def test_shapes_downgrade_without_disposable_safeguard_preserves_state(disposable_database):
    """Прямой Alembic reverse без disposable flag отклоняется до изменения заполненной head.

    Проверяется bypass CLI: semantic snapshots, raw shape rows, pin-ссылки,
    schema signatures и revision после отказа должны полностью сохраниться.
    """
    case = disposable_database
    _seed_legacy(case)
    migrations("upgrade", case.dsn)
    before, schema = _legacy_snapshot(case), _schema_snapshot(case)
    with case.connect() as connection:
        shapes = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM attributes.shapes ORDER BY id").fetchall()
        bindings = connection.execute("SELECT id,shape_id FROM attributes.definitions ORDER BY id").fetchall()
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="(?i)disposable"):
        command.downgrade(migration_config(case.dsn), LEGACY_HEAD)
    assert _legacy_snapshot(case) == before
    assert _schema_snapshot(case) == schema
    with case.connect() as connection:
        assert connection.execute("SELECT * FROM attributes.shapes ORDER BY id").fetchall() == shapes
        assert connection.execute("SELECT id,shape_id FROM attributes.definitions ORDER BY id").fetchall() == bindings
